notices: Loop 'problem_loop' returns each item through the new node 'problem_draft_stripped', which strips the item's text as specVersion 30 did.
Each deliverable is now delivered by pdf in a message of its own, where 30 sent one message for the job.

texts.explanation: loop-item-not-run: an item of a loop that did not run (past its max, or its body skipped) writes nothing at 31, where 30's template loop wrote its fixed text for it with its reads empty; that text is 30's alone (#1508, 2026-11-26, item 4, ruled by the owner (Q4 stands; both differences expected); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)

loop-item-strip-node: a loop whose .content is read returns each item through a node the migration wrote, which strips the item's text as 30 trimmed it: that node's text is 31's alone, and it is the item's text trimmed (#1509, comment 7207709261, item 1, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a rendered node for each such loop's ret strips each item); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)

loop-item-strip-node: a loop whose .content is read returns each item through a node the migration wrote, which strips the item's text as 30 trimmed it: that node's text is 31's alone, and it is the item's text trimmed (#1509, comment 7207709261, item 1, ruled by the owner on 2026-11-27 (a rendered node for each such loop's ret strips each item); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)

escaped-plain-text: plain text read into a Markdown deliverable is escaped (a computed text value too), and so are plain-text items joined into a Markdown loop's content, which a prompt reads escaped; unescaping the values the run held gives 30's bytes (part 06 § 6.4; part 10 § 3.2; D8; #1508, comment 5, items 7 (#13) and 8 (D23), ruled by the owner on 2026-11-25); loop-item-not-run: an item of a loop that did not run (past its max, or its body skipped) writes nothing at 31, where 30's template loop wrote its fixed text for it with its reads empty; that text is 30's alone (#1508, 2026-11-26, item 4, ruled by the owner (Q4 stands; both differences expected); part 10 §§ 1.2, 3.2)
